spans.s:
kím,
 —1. as nom. acc. s. n. to ká, see 1ká;
 —2. as interr. adv. [1111a], how ? 73^8.
why ? 18^10;
 —3. as interr. pcl.: num; kim
aham ajñas, am I a fool ? 39^21; an, 7813-,
 —4. in connection w. other pcls: kiṃ ca,
moreover, see ca 3; kiṃ tu, however, 20^12;
kiṃ cana, somewhat, 46^9; kim punar,
how much more (or less) ? 17^15. [see
under 1ká.]

kim-artha, a. having what as object;
kimártham, as adv. why ? [1302c 4.]

kim-prabhu, m. a bad master. [see
1ká 4, and 506.]
